name: Bank8
tagline: Banking, payments, and open banking on Sentin8 — a core ledger with double-entry postings, ISO 20022 payment orchestration, and FDX v6.5 data exchange.
pillarsLead: Bank8 inherits the Sentin8 security model by construction — every service runs behind the platform's authorization pipeline, tenant isolation, and post-quantum TLS.

pillars.title: Double-entry, provable invariants
pillars.summary: Posting batches are balance-validated per denomination before any write; balances, transactions, postings, audit, and outbox commit atomically.

pillars.title: Consent-checked data sharing
pillars.summary: Every FDX provider call passes the consent middleware (valid, unexpired, scope-covered) plus CSDF data minimization — no exceptions.

pillars.title: Idempotent money movement
pillars.summary: Postings and payment instructions are idempotent per key; retries are safe by construction, terminal states never regress.

pillars.title: Detection, never shadow-filing
pillars.summary: Compliance detects (KYC, screening, monitoring); Reporting is the single filing executor — separation of duty is structural.

pillars.title: Tenant isolation on every row
pillars.summary: Every table FORCE-RLS'd on env_id; customer-held records add holder scoping. The bank8 database is the vertical's own — the platform never queries it.

units.name: Bank8:Ledger
units.summary: The core ledger: accounts, products, double-entry postings, balances, schedules, and the full configuration library — the system of record for money positions.

units.name: Bank8:Payments
units.summary: Payment orchestration: instructions, ISO 20022 scheme flows, cards, mandates, rules — money movement over every rail, never shadow-writing the ledger.

units.name: Bank8:FDX
units.summary: FDX v6.5 open banking: consent-checked data sharing between institutions, notifications, recipient registry — the consent authority for every provider call.

units.name: Bank8:Reporting
units.summary: Regulatory reporting: jurisdiction registry, filing calendar, generation/packaging (XBRL/CSV), submission/amendment — the vertical's single filing executor.

units.name: Bank8:Risk
units.summary: Prudential risk: exposures, capital (Basel), liquidity (LCR/NSFR), IFRS 9 ECL, limit monitoring with breach events, stress scenarios.

units.name: Bank8:Compliance
units.summary: AML/CTF: KYC/CDD, beneficial ownership, PEP, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, alert/case lifecycle — detection only, filing via Reporting.

apps.name: eBank
apps.summary: The retail customer app: account opening, balances, transfers, statements, notifications — and the customer side of FDX consent review and revocation.

apps.name: eFinTech
apps.summary: The FDX recipient app: a fintech consuming consented bank data through the open-banking flows.

apps.name: eTeller
apps.summary: The staff terminal: teller operations, customer search, account servicing — behind the same Shield authorization as every app.

apps.name: Bank8 Admin
apps.summary: The staff dashboard: instance overview, product activation, FDX provider administration — RFW-rendered in Sentin8:Dash.

sdks.name: bank8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The unified namespace facade (bank8::ledger::…, bank8::payments::…) over the contracts crates — the typed integration surface for every bank8 API.

showcaseLead: Bank8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own — identity, events, storage, scheduling, and supervision come from the platform services.

showcase.name: Sentin8 — the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling — everything bank8 doesn't rebuild.
